note: Registry of externally-published BBQ results. Nothing here was measured by bbq_pipeline/. See README.md before comparing any of it against ../exports/.

helm_safety_v1.17.0.setup: 0-shot, multiple_choice_joint (model generates a single letter A/B/C), temperature 0, max_tokens 1, 1000 instances sampled from all categories
helm_safety_v1.17.0.caveat: HELM's BBQ target-matching is broken; s_DIS is a near-constant sample artifact and s_AMB is systematically pulled toward zero. See README.md section 'HELM caveat'.

anthropic_syscard.setup: Vendor-internal. Standard (non-extended) thinking mode unless noted; Opus 4.8 card states thinking disabled and no system prompt.
anthropic_syscard.caveat: Metric definitions match bbq_pipeline/bbq_metrics.py, but the prompt format, sampling and scoring path are unpublished. The Opus 4.8 card notes prior-model numbers shift between cards due to 'routine evaluation updates'.

openai_syscard_gpt5.caveat: OpenAI changed the eval setup between cards: GPT-4o is 0.97/0.72 in the o1 card and 0.88/0.85 here. Never compare across OpenAI cards.

checked_and_absent.google_gemma3: Gemma 3 Technical Report (arXiv:2503.19786) dropped BBQ; it reports baseline policy-violation, CBRN, memorization and PII detection only.
checked_and_absent.meta_llama: No official Meta model card reports BBQ. Third-party papers do, but with their own harnesses.
checked_and_absent.google_gemini: No BBQ table in the Gemini technical reports; HELM measurements only.
checked_and_absent.bigbench_bbq_lite_json: Raw per-model score JSON exists at github.com/google/BIG-bench/tree/main/bigbench/benchmark_tasks/bbq_lite_json/results, but only covers BIG-G / GPT-3 / PaLM (pre-2023) and scores multiple_choice_grade, not a bias score.
